questions.q: According to Branden, self-esteem functions like the immune system of what?
questions.why: Branden describes self-esteem as the immune system of consciousness.

questions.q: What metaphor does the author use to compare self-esteem's necessity?
questions.why: Self-esteem is likened to calcium, essential but not instantly fatal when lacking.

questions.q: Self-acceptance involves choosing to value yourself without what?
questions.why: Self-acceptance is defined as valuing yourself without practicing judgment.

questions.q: Which two pillars are linked to living purposefully?
questions.why: Pillars 5 and 6 are purpose and personal integrity, described as connected.

questions.q: In the nail‑biting example, what emotion triggered the behavior?
questions.why: The author attributes nail‑biting to stress from feeling behind on goals.
